title: Variance, which develops AI agents for compliance and fraud investigations, raised a $21.5M Series A led by Ten Eleven Ventures and joined by YC and others (Ryan Lawler/Axios)
summary: Ryan Lawler / Axios: Variance, which develops AI agents for compliance and fraud investigations, raised a $21.5M Series A led by Ten Eleven Ventures and joined by YC and others — Variance, which builds AI agents for compliance and fraud investigations, raised $21.5 million in Series A funding, CEO Karine Mellata tells Axios exclusively.
